functions.name: createTaskContext
params: { task, activeNodeId, activeNodeStatus, blockReason, reviewState, primaryAction, latestActivitySummary }

callGraph.callee:
[
    ...createAttentionHighlights(reviewState, blockReason),
    activeNodeHighlight,
    { label: "Next", value: primaryAction, tone: task.isRunnable ? "info" as const : "warning" as const },
    { label: "Task", value: task.title },
    { label: "State", value: task.status },
    { label: "Active node", value: nodeLabel ?? "No active node" },
    activityHighlight,
  ].filter

[
    task.id,
    task.status,
    activeNodeId ?? "none",
    activeNodeStatus ?? "none",
    blockReason ?? "none",
    reviewState ?? "none",
  ].join
